Done. The `Task` aggregate is implemented in `src/main/java/com/example/planning/Task.java` and all four endpoints work as specified.

**What I did**

Added `com.example.planning.Task` as a Prefab aggregate nested under `Project` via `@Parent @NotNull Reference<Project> project`:

- `@Create` constructor `(Reference<Project> project, @NotBlank String title)` sets `done = false` and `version = 0` — title is required (`@NotBlank`).
- `@GetById` / `@GetList` expose get-one and list (Spring Data page).
- `@Update(path = "/complete", method = "POST") complete()` returns the new state with `done = true`.

Prefab generated the controller with the exact paths the task requires (confirmed against `target/prefab/agent-context.md`):

- `POST /projects/{projectId}/tasks` → `201 Created`, `Location: /projects/{projectId}/tasks/{id}`
- `GET /projects/{projectId}/tasks/{id}` → `{id, title, done, …}`
- `GET /projects/{projectId}/tasks` → paged response with a `content` array, scoped to the parent project
- `POST /projects/{projectId}/tasks/{id}/complete` → `200 OK`

**Verification**

- `mvn -DskipTests compile` — model and generated code compile.
- Added `TaskIntegrationTest` (`@IntegrationTest` + generated `ProjectClient`/`TaskClient`) covering create→201, get-by-id (title + `done=false`), per-project listing (including that a *different* project sees no tasks, proving scoping), and complete→`done=true`.
- `mvn verify` — **BUILD SUCCESS**, `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`.

No hand-written controllers/entities/migrations were added — only the annotated record and a test, per the Prefab conventions in `CLAUDE.md`.

Done. The full build is green (6 tests, 0 failures, `BUILD SUCCESS`).

## What I changed

`src/main/java/com/example/crm/Customer.java` — added Jakarta validation on the `@Create` constructor parameters (per the Prefab cheat sheet, validation lives on the constructor parameters, not the record components):

```java
@Create
public Customer(@NotBlank @Size(max = 100) String name, @NotNull @Email String email) {
    this(Reference.create(), 0L, name, email);
}
```

- **`name`** → `@NotBlank` (required, not blank) + `@Size(max = 100)` (at most 100 chars)
- **`email`** → `@NotNull` (required) + `@Email` (valid e-mail address)

Prefab's generated `CustomerController` already applies `@Valid @RequestBody` to `CreateCustomerRequest`, so invalid bodies are rejected with `400 Bad Request` (Spring's default mapping of `MethodArgumentNotValidException`) before anything reaches the service or database, while valid bodies still return `201 Created`.

## Verification

I added `src/test/java/com/example/crm/CustomerCreateValidationTest.java` (`@IntegrationTest`, running the real HTTP layer over an in-process Postgres test container) covering all the requirements:

| Case | Result |
|---|---|
| valid name + valid email | `201 Created` |
| missing `name` | `400` |
| blank `name` (`"   "`) | `400` |
| `name` > 100 chars | `400` |
| missing `email` | `400` |
| invalid `email` (`"not-an-email"`) | `400` |

`mvn -Dtest=CustomerCreateValidationTest test` and the full `mvn verify` both pass — no hand-written controllers/entities/migrations, and nothing under `target/` was touched.
